The Faculty of Engineering at The University of Sydney (Sydney, Australia) invites applications for several academic positions at Lecturer, Senior Lecturer, and Associate Professor (Level B-D) across our Engineering schools. We are seeking academics whose research engages with AI, including, but not limited to:

LEVERAGE AI: Use AI to advance research, discovery, engineering practice, design, computation, education and other fields — applying AI to new problems and unlocking new possibilities. UNDERSTAND AI: Investigate how AI works, from its mathematical, computational and engineering foundations to its capabilities, limitations, behaviour, impacts and implications. BUILD AI: Develop the next generation of AI methods, models, systems, tools and technologies, and the engineering and computational foundations that enable them.

We welcome researchers whose connection to AI is established today, as well as those who can articulate how AI will shape their current or future research.

The call is targeted at all areas of Computer Science, but we welcome applications in HCI, including Human-Centred AI, Human-AI/Robot/Agent interaction, and Intelligent User Interfaces.
